game.q: why would a farmer let seed land on paths, rocks and thorns?
opts: his aim was just that bad
he throws wide, and the good soil makes up for it

wrong.aim: rude. he’s not missing, he’s throwing wide.
wrong.cheap: nope. the wide toss is the point, not the price.

game.right: YES. he throws wide and trusts the harvest.

end.line: birds, rocks and thorns took plenty. the good soil gave back a hundredfold.
end.l1: birds, rocks and thorns took plenty.
end.l2: the good soil gave a hundredfold.

cliff.s1: next: a seed you can barely see
cliff.s2: and a pinch of yeast in a mountain of dough.

share: birds ate it. the sun fried it. thorns choked it. then the harvest hit. the sower on infinite hill
